name: WANotifier
description: WANotifier on the official WhatsApp Business API: browse and update contacts, lists and tags, and send WhatsApp text, image and document replies inside the 24-hour conversation window.
instructions:
WANotifier is a WhatsApp marketing and notification tool built on Meta's official WhatsApp Business (Cloud) API. There is no QR code: your number is connected to the API inside WANotifier during onboarding, and Meta bills its per-message fees directly.

**Getting credentials**: in WANotifier open Automations, then Integrations. Under Direct Integrations click Manage on API Integration, open the API Keys tab and copy My API Key into `WANOTIFIER_API_KEY`. The key is sent as the `key` query parameter.

**Workflow**: start with `wanotifier_list_contact_lists` and `wanotifier_list_contact_tags` to learn the IDs, then `wanotifier_list_contacts` to find people. `wanotifier_upsert_contact` creates or updates a contact by WhatsApp number.

**Sending**: `wanotifier_send_text_message`, `wanotifier_send_image_message` and `wanotifier_send_document_message` only work inside an active 24-hour conversation window, i.e. the contact wrote to your number in the last 24 hours. Outside it WhatsApp only accepts approved templates. The REST API has no endpoint for templates: create a Transactional / Integration / API Notification in WANotifier and call its own webhook URL from your system instead. Every send is a real message, so confirm the recipient and the exact content with the user first.

**Formats**: WhatsApp numbers are E.164 with the plus sign and country code, e.g. `+919876543210`. Media must be a static public HTTPS file URL (no Google Drive pages): images jpeg or png up to 5 MB, documents txt, pdf, doc(x), xls(x), ppt(x) up to 100 MB.

**Pagination and limits**: `wanotifier_list_contacts` takes `page` and `per_page` (WANotifier's own default is 1, so the tool asks for 50) and returns `total`. The API allows 300 requests per minute per key; beyond that it answers 429. WhatsApp separately limits business-initiated conversations per day (250 for a new number, rising with quality and verification) and throughput to 80 messages per second. Paid plans are sized by contact tier, with a 7-day free trial.

**Cloud reachability**: `app.wanotifier.com` is a public HTTPS API, reachable from AnythingMCP Cloud and from self-hosted installs with internet access.

WANOTIFIER_API_KEY.label: WANotifier API key
WANOTIFIER_API_KEY.help: Automations, Integrations, Manage under API Integration, API Keys tab: copy My API Key.
WANOTIFIER_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, not a URL with ?key=.

tools.name: wanotifier_list_contact_lists
tools.description: List the contact lists in the WANotifier account with their numeric IDs and names. Use the IDs to filter contacts or to add a contact to a list.

tools.name: wanotifier_list_contact_tags
tools.description: List the contact tags in the WANotifier account with their numeric IDs and names. Use the IDs to filter contacts or to tag a contact.

tools.name: wanotifier_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search WANotifier contacts with ID, name, WhatsApp number, subscription status and dates. Filter by search term, list IDs or tag IDs; the answer carries total for paging.

search.description: Search term matched against contacts, e.g. a name or number.

list_ids.description: Comma-separated list IDs from wanotifier_list_contact_lists, e.g. 12345,23456.

page.description: Page number of the results, e.g. 2 for the second page.

tools.name: wanotifier_get_contact
tools.description: Get one WANotifier contact by numeric ID, including WhatsApp number, subscription status, lists, tags and custom attributes.

tools.name: wanotifier_upsert_contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or update the existing contact with the same WhatsApp number: name, custom attributes, lists, tags and subscription status. Confirm the changes with the user before calling.

whatsapp_number.description: E.164 number with + and country code, e.g. +919876543210.

attributes.description: Custom attributes as key/value pairs; keys lowercase with underscores, e.g. {"city": "Pune"}.

list_ids.description: List IDs to add the contact to.

status.description: Subscription status; WANotifier defaults to subscribed.

replace.description: True replaces existing attributes, lists and tags with the ones sent; false (default) adds to them.

tools.name: wanotifier_send_text_message
tools.description: Send a free-form WhatsApp text to a contact inside the 24-hour conversation window. This sends a real message: confirm the recipient and the exact text with the user before calling.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient as E.164 with +, e.g. +919876543210. Needed unless contact_id is given.

contact_id.description: Recipient contact ID; takes priority over whatsapp_number.

preview_url.description: Show a link preview for the first URL in the text.

tools.name: wanotifier_send_image_message
tools.description: Send an image (jpeg or png, up to 5 MB, static public HTTPS URL) to a contact inside the 24-hour window. This sends a real message: confirm the recipient, image and caption with the user first.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient as E.164 with +, e.g. +919876543210. Needed unless contact_id is given.

contact_id.description: Recipient contact ID; takes priority over whatsapp_number.

link.description: Static public HTTPS URL of the image file.

tools.name: wanotifier_send_document_message
tools.description: Send a document (pdf, doc(x), xls(x), ppt(x) or txt, up to 100 MB, static public HTTPS URL) inside the 24-hour window. This sends a real message: confirm the recipient and the file with the user first.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient as E.164 with +, e.g. +919876543210. Needed unless contact_id is given.

contact_id.description: Recipient contact ID; takes priority over whatsapp_number.

link.description: Static public HTTPS URL of the document.

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient, e.g. Invoice-1042.pdf.
